AboutSyngentaDesc:
With the foundation of more than 250-year history, Syngenta is one of the world’s leading agriculture companies, with headquarters in Basel, Switzerland. In more than 100 countries we are working to transform how crops are grown. We aim to improve the sustainability, quality and safety of agriculture with world class science and innovative crop solutions. Our technologies enable millions of farmers around the world to make better use of limited agricultural resources.

Syngenta has been a long-standing partner in Vietnam’s agriculture industry since 1990s. Over the past 30 years, farmers across Vietnam have benefited from Syngenta’s crop protection solutions, high-quality hybrid seeds, superior vegetable seeds, and professional technical support. This has increased the quantity and quality, value and competitiveness of Vietnam’s agricultural output, including corn, rice, coffee, potato, pepper and other local crops.

Each year about 16 million hecta of crops are protected with our crop protection products & about 230 thousand hecta of corn, rice and vegetables are planted with our seeds and millions of people being protected from community diseases thru our public health products.

Syngenta is the first agricultural FDI company investing in R&D facilities in Vietnam. About $1.5 million spent on development activities in VN annually to develop, test, evaluate and trial products which gives Vietnamese farmers early access to fit-for-purpose technologies, helping to achieve reduction in production losses, providing greater consistency in yield and quality. With an eye on the future of agriculture in Vietnam, we will continue to support farmers and communities across Vietnam to improve their agricultural products and output, mitigate the effects of climate change on their livelihoods, and ensure access to safe and innovative products that secure the country’s prosperous future

BookingToolAdditionalInfo:
A seed treater is a versatile machine that allows you to treat seeds with Syngenta’s leading pipeline of products before you commence sowing. Using a seed treater, you can treat between 10 to 35 kilograms of seeds at once, depending on seed size. It can be used to treat different crops such as corn, cotton, wheat, and rice.
•	Convenience for you to have seeds treated before sowing.
•	Peace of mind regarding proper application/dose accuracy.
•	A professional and versatile machine that gives high-quality output.
BookingToolBenefitsDesc:
•	Simplified process for booking the seed treater service, finding the right slot, and getting confirmation.
•	Easily available at Cropwise and other local platforms.
•	Better planning and flexibility regarding when to treat seeds.
•	The same booking tool platform can be used to book other services that may be offered by Seedcare in the future. For example, loading analysis, training, etc.
BookingToolDesc:
Want to treat your seeds with the best Seedcare products and technologies on your own farm?
With Syngenta Seedcare’s Seed Treating Booking Service, we offer you the convenience of performing seed treatment with professional equipment and trained operators at your own property and at a pre-specified date/time. By treating your seeds through this service, we guarantee dose accuracy, high-quality treated seeds, convenience, and peace of mind.
Don’t miss this chance and book your slot today!
BookingToolWork: How Does the Booking Tool Work?
BookingToolWorkDesc: The Booking Tool is a new service by Syngenta Pakistan that promises easy access to professional seed treatment machines. It’s aimed towards mid- and large-scale growers across Pakistan. With this tool, you can easily book a seed treater from the comfort of your home using the Cropwise app and treat seeds right on your farm. All you have to do is fill out a short form and our franchisee will get in touch with you.

BuyPesticides:
Exercise caution at all times when handling pesticides.
Buy Pesticides in their original, undamaged, container packing with clear legible labels.
Do not transport pesticides along with food-stuff / feed-stuff. 
Store pesticides under lock and key away from food, humans, and animals.
The rooms or premises meant for storing the pesticide should be well-built, dry, well lit and have sufficient ventilation within the storage room.
Before use, carefully read and understand the product label and leaflet.
Always use the recommended dosage of pesticide.
Maintain application equipment in good working condition.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling or spraying the pesticides.
Use a stick for stirring the spray mixture.
Do not use your mouth to unblock nozzles.
Always wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment for mixing, loading and spraying of Pesticides. Spray along the wind.
Do not store unused spray mixture.
Spray the unused Pesticide spray mix over part of the field not previously treated in diluted quantities.
Wash your Spraying apparatus and PPE with clean water daily after use.
Take bath and wash clothes after spraying application.
Empty Pesticide containers/packaging should be triple rinsed, punctured and disposed of according to local law and regulations. Do not reuse empty containers
Avoid environmental contamination.
In case of any poisoning immediately rush or consult to doctor.
